en.name: Reindsurm Practice
en.effect: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

zh-CN.name: 轮回虫龙之修练
zh-CN.effect: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：从牌组将2只“轮回虫龙”怪兽加入手牌。然后，挑选自己的1张手牌送至墓地。然后，对手场上或墓地存在龙族怪兽的情况下，可从自己墓地将1只昆虫族怪兽加入手牌。②：此卡存在于墓地的状态下，自己将昆虫族怪兽仪式召唤的情况下，将此卡除外可以发动。从牌组将1张“轮回虫龙”场地魔法卡以表侧表示放在自己场上。
